question: Vajíčka od babky z dvora mávajú často sýtooranžový žĺtok, kým tie z obchodu sú bledšie. Čo farbu žĺtka v skutočnosti určuje?
source_excerpt: The color of the egg yolk depends on the absorption and deposition of the carotenoids in the hen diet.

extra.why_interesting: Slovaks widely believe that grandma's deep-orange yolks mean a healthier or 'more real' egg. In fact the colour simply reflects what the hen ate, and the colour can even be boosted by adding paprika to the feed.
extra.verification_notes: Yolk colour is determined mainly by dietary carotenoids (xanthophylls) in hen feed, per https://acervodigital.unesp.br/handle/11449/117506; no newer development contradicts this.

explanation: Žĺtok zafarbujú farbivá z potravy, napríklad z trávy, kukurice či papriky. Chovatelia preto niekedy do krmiva pridávajú mletú papriku, a o výživovej hodnote vajca farba takmer nič nehovorí.

question: Keď sa na salaši pozriete ovci alebo koze zblízka do očí, zistíte, že jej zreničky nie sú okrúhle ako naše. Aký tvar majú?
source_excerpt: of 42 herbivorous prey animals in their database, 36 had horizontal pupils.

extra.why_interesting: Every Slovak has seen sheep and goats on a salaš or at a petting zoo, yet few have noticed their eyes. Most people assume the pupils are round or vertical like a cat's. They are actually horizontal rectangles, and the eyes swivel to keep them level while the animal grazes.
extra.verification_notes: Sheep and goats have horizontally elongated, rectangular pupils, as reported in Smithsonian and Live Science coverage of the Berkeley/Durham study; no newer developments found.

explanation: Ležatá zrenica jej dáva takmer panoramatický výhľad, takže si pri pasení všimne vlka skoro odkiaľkoľvek. Keď skloní hlavu k tráve, oči sa jej v jamkách otočia, aby zrenica zostala vodorovná.
